notes.subject: Eloa
notes.rationale: Wotoro manna dilannen (Eloah) min ma di Yawe ye — 'Ala' walima masabagacɛ-ko-fɔli; ni tɔgɔ senuman kɔnɔ a ye jɔsili ye

notes.subject: to Eliifaz/Job
notes.rationale: Kumasen in ye ɲɛsɔn ko-yɔrɔ ye min bɛ fɔ Elifaz ka numanko ɲɛ na, hadamaden siratigɛ la

notes.subject: yɛlɛmɛ-ɲɛmɛn
notes.rationale: Kɔrɔda 'sedek' ye kɛ-kɔrɔ ɲuman ye; ge-Kan dɔnniyali tɛ se ka a lasɔrɔ ni daɲɛ kelen ye

translation: Yala hadamaden bɛ se ka kɛ yɛlɛmɛ-ɲɛmɛn ye Eloa la? Yala geba bɛ se ka kɛ finbalen ye a Dilabaga ɲɛ?
